name: Chandrayaan-2 Orbiter
fact: India's orbiter is still mapping the Moon years after launch. It reached the Moon on a slow, fuel-saving route.

name: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter
fact: LRO has photographed every Apollo landing site from orbit.

name: Mangalyaan (MOM)
fact: Launched November 2013 on a PSLV, reached Mars orbit in September 2014 on a famously small budget.

name: MAVEN
fact: Reached Mars orbit on 21 September 2014, three days before Mangalyaan.

name: Juno
fact: Launched August 2011, reached Jupiter July 2016. Uses three giant solar panels because sunlight at Jupiter is so weak.
